title: Disable weight decay at DEPTH=10
description: Changed WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.0 (cautious Muon weight decay), all else at DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.006934, worse than the 1.002530 baseline. Weight decay is helping, not hurting, even in this short 5-minute training regime -- the cautious decay (only applied when grad and param agree in sign) plus its own linear decay to 0 was apparently already close to correct. Don't zero out WEIGHT_DECAY again; if anyone wants to explore this axis further, try smaller perturbations (e.g. 0.1 or 0.3) rather than the extreme of turning it off.
